🎯 Why this is worth a section rather than a footnote

An engine you cannot inspect is an engine you have to trust. Every table here exists because a specific class of error was invisible without it — a frozen derived field, a figure computed twice in two places, a safety net where half the checks never fired. None of those show up as an error message; they show up as a number that is quietly wrong under a configuration you did not test.
Pure documentation. Nothing here writes to the model, and no control on this page can change a case.
